nodes.label: SocialAuthService
nodes.rationale: Refuses unverified provider emails and takes over unverified local accounts by resetting their password, preventing pre-registration takeover.

nodes.label: Lenis Smooth Scrolling
nodes.rationale: Lenis owns page scroll, so scrollIntoView is overridden; use lenis.scrollTo and data-lenis-prevent for inner scroll areas.

nodes.label: Auth Page Swap (View Transitions)
nodes.rationale: Unnamed content lives in the root snapshot painted below named layers, so moving/top elements need unique view-transition names or the browser skips the transition.

nodes.label: Layered Architecture (Controller -> Service -> Repository -> Model)
nodes.rationale: Layers call downward only; services depend on repository interfaces, never Eloquent; repositories are the only place that queries models.

nodes.label: Deferred Email Sending (defer())
nodes.rationale: Keeps response time equal for known/unknown emails (no enumeration) and a broken mail server doesn't fail the request; no queue worker needed.

nodes.label: JWT Refresh Token Rotation
nodes.rationale: Refresh tokens stored hashed and rotated on every use; replaying a used token revokes the whole session chain.

nodes.label: CurrentUser (JwtCurrentUser / GuestUser)
nodes.rationale: Role is read from the database so a demotion applies immediately.
